lint_rules.rule: Naming per QNSC_RTL_Design_Naming_Rule V1.0 (rtl_rule.md section 1): module m_qnsc_<function>, ports i_/o_ prefixed, interrupts i_int_*/o_int_*, w_*/r_* signals, P_/C_/S_ uppercase constants, underscore before index digit, 'int' not 'irq'.
Shared numbers (interrupt lines, line counts, widths, addresses) come from qnsc_pkg C_* constants via import qnsc_pkg::*; never typed literally.

Module structure: header comment with spec section and REQ-IDs; module, import, parameters, grouped ports with comments; localparam, signals, assign/always_comb, always_ff, instances; assertions inside `ifndef SYNTHESIS.
R1/R3: sequential logic uses always_ff with async-assert/sync-deassert reset and <= only (not applicable to INTMAP, which has no state).
R2/R4: combinational logic uses always_comb or assign, never always @(*); every always_comb assigns defaults first (no latch).
R6: every case has a default; unique case for fully enumerated types.
R7: logic only; no reg, wire, integer in RTL.
R8: named port and parameter connections only; no positional, no .*.
R9: widths explicit; cast rather than rely on padding.
R10: a module with state has i_clk_* and i_rst_n_*; a purely combinational module has neither.
R11/R12: cross-domain signals via qnsc_sync or MAS-specified handshake; no clock gating in RTL except a vendored clock-gate cell.
Forbidden: #delay, initial, casex/casez, defparam, implicit nets, intentional latches, multi-driven nets, $random/$display, inout inside the core, typed shared numbers.
Lint gate: make -C $QSOC check clean (Verilator -Wall no warning from the new file, flow/lint/naming_check.py, flow/lint/hardcode_check.py).
